issues.where: the perched colony across the center and right cliff
issues.what: the same pale folded wings, ribbed bodies and hooked neck poses recur across the benches, so the colony reads as copies of one sculpt
issues.fix: vary body shapes, wing folds, neck poses and silhouettes, and give the colony uneven staining and local contact shadows

issues.where: the foreground water around the rocks and across the foot of the breaker
issues.what: the bright, turbulent wave runs into a straight, calm gray plane; big rocks pierce it with almost no wake or foam
issues.fix: carry aerated water and irregular ripples out from the breaker, and add localized wash, menisci and wet edges around the rocks

issues.what: the same black and white bands stretch over rounded corners and down wall faces, making the bench texture look smeared onto a mesh
issues.fix: break up the runoff by slope and drainage and give the horizontal faces and vertical rock distinct surface detail

issues.what: the wing and neck edges have stepped translucent ghosts rather than a continuous blur
issues.fix: use continuous motion blur with enough temporal samples to preserve a coherent wing silhouette

issues.where: left crop, feet of the long-legged animal in the center
issues.what: the toes skim the ledge without a clear grip or contact shadow, so the animal looks unweighted
issues.fix: seat the toes against the uneven surface and add local occlusion at each load-bearing foot

issues.where: lower-right crop, close rock under the gray ridge
issues.what: a straight shelf exposes a strip of vertically dragged texture above a glossy, almost black face
issues.fix: reshape the shelf into irregular stone breaks and remap the exposed faces with less uniform gloss and some sky fill

issues.where: upper-right and lower-left crops, spray in front of the breaker and right wall
issues.what: the dense spray resolves into a nearly uniform pale veil, with little depth or light separation from the foam behind it
issues.fix: separate backlit fine mist, darker dense water and foreground droplets, and let clear gaps reveal the wall at different depths

issues.where: right crop, water behind and in front of the rock cluster
issues.what: evenly spaced horizontal bands cross the surface, while pale film-like collars stretch off the rocks
issues.fix: replace the regular banding with irregular surface and reflection detail, and confine aerated flow to the actual water-rock contact
